answer: Because the timing is recorded against the signal challenge, the knoll audit can replay the lantern history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 130 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 2 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
